title: i18n: `plugin-auth` and `service-automation` read a failed tenant-settings read as "no default", like #27257; adopt `readFailed` once it lands (automation fails the `notify` run)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

Blocked-by: #27257

The sibling card triage `6506866652` on #27257 ordered ("This seat files them as one sibling card (`domain:server`, p2, `Blocked-by: #27257`), which reads the new member").

## What is wrong

`resolveLocalizationContext` (`packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts`) cannot tell "no tenant default" from "the `sys_setting` read failed". #27257 adds one optional `readFailed?: true` on its result and makes the messaging channels grade a failed read retryable. Two more callers make the same fold and are left as they are by that PR:

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` (~L1106, on `main` @ `a75ddba1`): a transient read failure is read as "no default".
- `packages/services/service-automation` (~L1436): the same fold fails the `notify` run, as a permanent outcome, where a retry would succeed.

## Expected

Once #27257 lands, both read `readFailed` and treat a failed read as transient (retry or fall back as each caller's own contract says), never as "the tenant has no default". A read that succeeds and finds no default keeps today's behaviour. Pins: a read fault → the transient path; a real "no default" → unchanged.

`domain:server`, `priority:p2` per triage `6506866652`.
